description: Create a payment request: who receives, which token, how much, on which network. Returns invoice.id, invoice.label (INV-XXXX-XXXX, what people copy), invoice.url (share this, after paying the analysis charge if the invoice has one; it previews with the QR on WhatsApp and Telegram) and invoice.qr (PNG). No signature or API key needed. New invoices only receive VERIFIED dollar stablecoins on the network allowlist, even without paid analysis. A new invoice without payerChecks carries no fee; with payerChecks, the analysis fee of both wallets is deducted from the amount through the split (see payerChecks). Previously created invoices keep their terms. Tokens resolve by address or symbol — an unverified token is refused because a cloned "USDC" with its own pool would let the creator sell a fake at any price. The payer can pay with ANY token on that network. Paid checks in checks are closed for new invoices (paid_check_moved): use payerChecks. the free screening of the receiving wallet must pass for the invoice to be created (receiver_blocked 403, screening_unavailable 503), and payerChecks adds the paid analysis of both wallets, paid by the fee deducted from the amount. A paid tool in payerChecks that Vurto switched off is left out and not charged, and the answer lists it in skippedChecks (never an error).

amount.description: Human decimal amount, e.g. "100". Decimals come from the token list, not from you.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checks.description: Closed for new invoices (07/11/2026): a paid check here ("scorechain", "merkle-science") is refused with paid_check_moved, on every network. Use payerChecks for the analysis of the paying wallet, and the payer buys the analysis of the receiving wallet with invoice_analysis_pay. Invoices created before keep their charge, paid by the creator with invoice_analysis_pay. Any other value is refused with invalid_check.

confidential.description: true creates a private invoice, paid through the Vurto Private Contract. It exists only where that contract is published for this network and token: elsewhere 400 private_coming_soon and nothing is created. It takes no payerChecks (private_invoice_checks): the paid analyses the contract runs on whoever pays go in confidentialChecks, chosen by the creator (since 19/11/2026). On an EVM network where the VurtoPrivateSplit is published the fee comes out of the amount inside the same transaction that deposits the rest into the contract (no separate charge, at most 10% of the amount plus 1.20 USD); elsewhere, and whenever that contract is not available for the entry (paused, or not switched on for that network or token), it is charged at the contract entry, before the deposit. It is paid ONLY on its page (the link), never through invoice_pay (409 private_invoice_vault_only), because a direct transfer would show both wallets on-chain; whoever pays needs an approved KYC to enter the contract. Reading it gives confidential: true, privateContract: true and recipient null. Only the boolean true asks for it: any other value except false is refused with private_coming_soon, so a string never turns into a common invoice you think is private.

confidentialChecks.description: Only with confidential true (since 19/11/2026, whoever configures chooses): the paid analyses the Vurto Private Contract runs on whoever pays, besides the free screening that always runs. merkle-science, crystal or both (both is safer); scorechain is an optional extra on top, never enough alone. Absent or [] is merkle-science AND crystal; a list without either of them gets both added. Stored on the invoice and shown in invoice_get confidentialChecks; the payer does not choose. Whoever pays pays it out of the amount, two consultations (payer and receiver): 1.20 USD with one of merkle-science or crystal, 2.40 USD with both, 0.30 USD more with scorechain, and the minimum is 20 times that fee (at least 25 USD; 48 USD with both, 54 USD with the three). A chosen tool the operator switched off falls to the other one (and while the Check pauses crystal on Solana, a private payment on Solana runs and charges merkle-science instead); with neither on, 503 private_contract_unavailable. Crystal needs the payer's KYC, which the contract asks of every payer anyway. Anything else is 400 invalid_private_checks.

memo.description: Optional note, up to 80 chars, visible to anyone with the link.

payerChecks.description: Solana and EVM networks with invoiceSplit=true in /v1/chains, stablecoin invoices only: USDC, USDT (including USDT0), PYUSD, USDG and USD1, by verified address on each network. Availability differs by network. You (the receiver) choose the PAID analysis of the PAYER wallet; your own wallet goes through the same tools. One analysis fee covers both wallets, the same with one tool or two: two consultations at the fixed price (https://docs.vurto.cc/fees), deducted from the amount through the split. invoice.split comes back with rule "flat", fee and receiverAmount: the payer sends the amount and you receive receiverAmount. There is no charge to pay first, so the link can be shared right away. Below the minimum: amount_below_analysis_minimum (400, details.minimum). It runs when the payer calls invoice_pay, after the free screening passes, and no field switches it off. The result goes to you alone, on the site, signed in with this wallet: invoice_get here does not carry it. "crystal" (Crystal Risk Check, direct, since 17/11/2026) is only for a PROVEN wallet whose identity check (KYC) is approved: an agent proves the receiving wallet with kyc_proof_challenge, prepare_signing and kyc_proof, and passes the walletProof it returns (30 minutes) in this call; without it the call is refused with kyc_wallet_signature_required (401), and without the KYC with kyc_required (403); nothing is created. The KYC itself is done once by the person, on the site. It is sold at the same price per consultation as Merkle Science, on top of the fixed one, so the fee and the minimum rise with it, and it covers Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum One, Avalanche and Solana (not Gnosis nor Unichain). It reads on the same 0 to 100 scale as Merkle Science; a wallet Crystal has no data on is never called clean (it reads as not read, and does not block a payment by itself). Refused: split_not_available_on_chain where no split contract is configured, stablecoin_required for tokens outside the network allowlist, amount_below_analysis_minimum below the minimum, analysis_tool_unavailable (503) when the tool is not answering, and nothing is created or charged.

recipient.description: Who receives: a wallet (EVM 0x address, or base58 on Solana, case-sensitive) or a Vurto user as "@handle". With "@handle" the Vurto Profile picks one of that user's wallets on this network (random among the ones they marked for regular or, with confidential, private transfers; the rotation only moves after a confirmed payment), the invoice carries recipientHandle, and the free screening runs on the wallet picked. On a regular invoice the payment transaction still carries that wallet; only the private one keeps it from the payer. recipient_unavailable (400) is the same answer for a handle that does not exist and one with no wallet on this network.

token.description: Token to receive: address/mint or symbol of a verified dollar stablecoin on the network allowlist. Other tokens return stablecoin_required, even without paid analysis.

walletProof.description: Only with "crystal": the walletProof of THIS wallet (the receiver on invoice_create, the payer on payout_batch) from kyc_proof (vkp_..., 30 minutes). Secret. It proves the wallet is yours; the KYC itself is read from that wallet.

name: invoice_create
